description: Figure 6a presents the distribution of video types within a benchmark dataset. The pie chart displays 12 categories. These are, proceeding roughly clockwise from the largest segment: People Blogs at 17.2%, Entertainment at 13.9%, Education at 8.7%, Howto & Style at 9.7%, Film & Animation at 4.6%, Sports at 6.4%, Gaming at 4.6%, Music at 3.9%, Autos & Vehicles at 4.8%, Pets & Animals at 6.4%, Travel & Events at 4.0%, and Science & Technology at 3.7%. The chart includes a legend labeling each category and its corresponding color. Percentage labels are displayed inside each slice. The slices are visually ordered from largest to smallest, though this is a descriptive observation and not an interpretation of significance.
